newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SHARES SEEN LITTLE CHANGED AFTER BULL RUN.
newsitem.headline: SHARES SEEN LITTLE CHANGED AFTER BULL RUN.

text.p: Hungarian share prices are expected to change little after a seven-session bull run, traders said.

"The market has risen for seven days...this can induce some profit-taking," said Tamas Revesz of Wintrust. "On the other hand corporate earnings are good and the dollar is strong, so I expect the market to edge higher," he said.
But Marton Olah of Creditanstalt Securities expected most shares to give up some of their gains as prices turned overheated after earnings by leading companies on Thursday.
"I expect slight weakening...despite the dollar's strength, as the Dow eased," he said.
The Hungarian forint opened at 197.22/32 to the dollar, reflecting the U.S. unit's overnight strenghtening, compared to 196.15/20 at Thursday's close.
Budapest bourse-listed companies have started to release their first half earnings reports.
On Friday plastics industrial Pannonplast , Inter-Europa Bank , garment factory Styl and pharmaceuticals Human published their January-June figures.
Trading in North American Bus Maker NABI Rt will start on Friday.
On Thursday the BUX index finished at 7,880.16 points.
